review_candidates.title: Cabin Crew Opportunities
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose A personality that shines, the ability to adapt to any situation and make people feel at ease. These are a few of the qualities we’re looking for in our cabin crew. As the face of Emirates, you’ll be the person customers turn to for help and direction when they fly with us, so you need to be friendly, observant and able to provide the right support. Being a member of the cabin crew is so much more than a service role - safety is our highest priority. You’ll need to lead confidently and take control when it comes to managing aircraft services, security, and safety procedures. This comes from the world-class learning experience our crew receive at our state-of-the-art facility in Dubai. Qualifications & Experience Here are some other things we look for in our cabin crew: You’ve had more than a year’s experience in hospitality/customer service You have a positive attitude and the natural ability to provide excellent service in a team environment, dealing with people from many cultures Your minimum qualification is high school graduate (Grade 12) You need to be fluent in written and spoken English You’re at least 160cm tall and can reach 212 cm while standing on tiptoes, to enable you to reach emergency equipment on all aircraft types No visible tattoos while you’re in Emirates cabin crew uniform (without covering them with bandages or cosmetics) As Emirates cabin crew, you’ll be based in Dubai and will need to meet the UAE's employment visa requirements Aside from the requirements of the role, you should be determined to always perform to the highest standards, focus on being solution oriented, and be able to manage a demanding work schedule. You should have the ability to deliver an authentic experience to our customers. You’ll be culturally aware and reflect the Emirates personality - professional, empathetic, progressive, visionary and cosmopolitan. Salary & Benefits Your pay is made up of three components: a fixed basic salary, an hourly pay for operated flights and an overseas meal allowance. Basic salary = AED 4,980 / month, Flying Pay = AED 69.60 / hour based on avg. 80-100 hours / month, Average Total Pay = AED 11,244 / month (~USD 3,100, EUR 2,600 or GBP 2,280) * These are approximate numbers for Grade II (Economy Class). Meal allowances for night stops are credited to the salary in arrears the following month. Hotel accommodation as well as transport to and from the airport is provided by the company. Join Emirates as cabin crew and enjoy a competitive, tax-free salary, flying pay, profit share, and concessional travel. Benefit from comprehensive relocation support to help you settle in Dubai, along with free accommodation and transportation. You will also receive excellent medical, life, and dental insurance, and more. Additionally, your friends and family can enjoy discounted flights, creating lasting memories together.

By integrating modern technology with the best people, we drive businesses forward in sustainable and smart ways. We do this by offering a range of specialist services, from which our partners can pick and choose depending on their needs. Our range of expert services have been crafted to help businesses modernize and thrive at any point in their journey. They include support, sales, VIP, CRM, Payments, Payouts, Anti-fraud, Risk Management, and more. Whether they’re just starting out and need a hand, or have a huge project in the pipeline, we’re here to guide them and do the heavy lifting where needed. Our values center on providing our assistance in a friendly and human fashion, cutting out the corporate tape to deliver a practical and holistic service. We build trust, and value long-term partnerships that allow our customers, and our team to grow together. Role Overview: We are seeking a highly analytical and leadership-driven CRM Operations Team Lead to support the execution of CRM strategies by leading the daily operations of the CRM team. Ensure smooth implementation of player engagement campaigns, lifecycle journeys, and retention initiatives. The CRM Operations Team Leader works closely with cross-functional teams and reports to the Head of CRM to drive player loyalty, optimize retention, and improve the customer experience through data-driven campaign execution. Responsibilities: Coordinate and oversee the day-to-day operations of the CRM team, ensuring timely and accurate execution of multi-channel campaigns (email, push, in-app, SMS); Implement and manage customer journeys across different segments, using CRM tools to automate and personalize the player experience; Work with CRM systems and data tools to set up, test, and optimize campaigns in alignment with the overall CRM strategy; Support audience segmentation, campaign planning, and lifecycle marketing based on player behavior and data insights; Maintain CRM documentation, processes, and campaign calendars to ensure operational efficiency and team alignment; Support the development and training of junior CRM executives or coordinators, helping build a skilled and efficient team; Contribute ideas for improving CRM workflows, automation, and campaign performance. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in CRM operations, preferably within the gaming, entertainment, or digital product industries; Hands-on experience working with CRM platforms to execute automated campaigns and manage customer lifecycles; Strong understanding of data-driven marketing and customer segmentation; Familiarity with A/B testing, campaign reporting, and performance analysis; Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously; Team leadership experience or demonstrated ability to mentor junior staff and coordinate cross-functional efforts; Passion for gaming and a good understanding of player behavior and motivations; Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement; Experience with Smartico will be considered as an advantage. Our reward to you is: Competitive remuneration package and social benefits; Food vouchers; Premium Health Insurance coverage; Discount on Multisport / CoolFit card; Free snacks and beverages in the office and Happy Hour on Fridays; Friendly environment with colleagues ready to share their experience; Team-building events and activities; Great office building location in Sofia, Office X, blvd 51 Cherni Vrah, next to Mall Paradise. If you are interested, please send us CV in English. All applications will of course be treated in the strictest confidentiality. Only the short-listed candidates will be contacted!

review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description: MSquare Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an AI automation and systems integration company specialising in workflow automation, Make.com, n8n, API integrations, and business process optimisation. We help agencies, SaaS companies, and operational businesses in Europe and North America eliminate manual processes, improve efficiency, and scale their operations through intelligent automation solutions. Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Business Development Manager to drive business growth, generate new opportunities, build strategic client relationships, and convert prospects into long-term customers. The ideal candidate will have strong B2B sales experience, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to understand client requirements and position automation solutions that address business challenges. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities in international markets, particularly Europe and North America. Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospective clients through LinkedIn, email outreach, networking, referrals, and other channels. Engage with founders, agency owners, operations managers, and SaaS decision-makers. Conduct discovery calls to understand client requirements, operational challenges, and business objectives. Present MSquare's AI automation, workflow integration, and business process optimisation solutions. Coordinate with technical teams to assess project feasibility, define scope, and prepare proposals and estimates. Lead sales discussions, handle objections, negotiate pricing, and close deals. Develop and maintain long-term client relationships to encourage repeat business, referrals, and account expansion. Maintain accurate CRM records, track sales activities, and provide regular pipeline and revenue reports. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and potential opportunities for business expansion. Work towards monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of qualified business opportunities generated. Monthly and quarterly revenue generated. Number of deals closed and overall conversion rate. Average deal value. Client acquisition and retention. Follow-up consistency and sales pipeline management. CRM accuracy and reporting discipline. Required Experience Minimum 2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or consultative selling. Proven experience in acquiring clients and closing business deals. Experience dealing with international clients, preferably in the US or European markets. Experience selling IT services, SaaS products, automation solutions, or agency services is highly desirable. Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and build a sustainable sales pipeline. Required Skills Excellent spoken and written business English. Strong lead generation, prospecting, and client acquisition skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities. Ability to understand business challenges and recommend appropriate solutions. Confidence in handling objections, discussing pricing, and closing deals. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in CRM tools such as HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Close. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple sales opportunities. Preferred Qualifications Experience selling AI automation, workflow automation, SaaS, or IT consulting services. Familiarity with tools such as n8n, Make.com, APIs, and business process automation. Experience working with international clients across different time zones. Knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach, and sales pipeline management. Compensation & Incentives Competitive fixed monthly salary based on experience and skills. Performance-based incentives and commissions linked to business development and revenue targets. Opportunity to grow with an expanding AI automation and technology solutions company. Who Should Apply? We are looking for a business development professional who takes ownership of the sales process, understands client needs, builds meaningful business relationships, and consistently works towards measurable revenue growth. If you are passionate about B2B sales, international business development, and technology-driven solutions, we would love to hear from you. Apply Now: hr@msquare.pro
